Figure 1:ReLift combines pretrained 2D tracking and 3D geometry
with learned trajectory repair and completion, achieving state-of-the-art
dense 3D tracking accuracy on WorldTrack and a strong speed–accuracy trade-off.Left:Long-range 3D trajectories recovered from a real-world video.Right:WorldTrack accuracy versus full-pipeline FPS
(see AppendixD.4for details).

Figure 2:Inference pipeline of ReLift.Frozen pretrained models lift video observations
(a–b) into corrupted and incomplete 3D trajectories (c). The corrector adds residuals to
initialized XYZ coordinates to produce the final trajectories (d–e). Below: ray–point tokensϕt​i\bm{\phi}_{ti}are grouped intoCC-frame tracklets and embedded as tokens𝐡n​i\mathbf{h}_{ni},
then processed by alternating temporal and across-track attention. The output head predicts
frame-level XYZ residuals, which are added to the initialized trajectories. We train the corrector
on simulated lifts from clean trajectory annotations (Sec.3.4).

Figure 4:Qualitative comparison.Top to bottom:
DyCheckspin(Gao et al., 2022)and DAVIScar-shadowandlibby(Perazzi et al., 2016).
Trajectories of the same reference pixels are shown from matched novel viewpoints.
Ours uses AllTracker and VGGT-Ω\Omega; TrackCraft3R shares this geometry,
while 4RC and V-DPM use their own reconstructions. Yellow boxes mark
magnified regions.

Figure 8:Additional qualitative comparisons.Top: DAVISsoccerball; bottom:lady-running. Ours uses CoWTracker with VGGT-Ω\Omega(top) and AllTracker with DA3 (bottom),
with the same corrector weights (C=4C=4). TrackCraft3R uses VGGT-Ω\Omegain both rows
(unlike ours inlady-running); 4RC and V-DPM use their own reconstructions.
Methods track the same reference pixels, shown on their respective reconstructions from matched
novel viewpoints.

Figure 9:Effect of trajectory correction.Left to right: input frame, initialized lift,
and corrected trajectories (C=4C=4). Top: DAVIScamel; bottom:skate-park.
CoWTracker’s 2D tracks and DA3 geometry are held fixed; both trajectory panels use the same
point cloud and novel viewpoint.
